reviews.summary: A NEAR network upgrade is in progress on November 4, 2026, with transfer/settlement interruptions reported through November 5. This is a current operational risk for NEAR-EUR despite spot trading remaining available on at least one venue.
materialRisks: NEAR network upgrade/maintenance is active from November 4 00:00 UTC to November 5 00:00 UTC; ChangeNOW reports potential NEAR exchange and payout delays. ([status.changenow.io](https://status.changenow.io/index.html?utm_source=openai))

MEXC temporarily suspended NEAR deposits and withdrawals from November 4 00:00 UTC pending network stability, although it states NEAR spot trading is unaffected. ([mexc.fm](https://www.mexc.fm/announcements/article/mexc-to-support-near-protocol-near-network-upgrade-17827791539417?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The supplied snapshot was collected at 15:21 UTC on November 4, 2026—inside the announced NEAR upgrade window.
The observed operational impact is transfer-related, not an announced suspension of NEAR spot trading on MEXC.

No discrete vesting-token unlock is currently scheduled; remaining supply growth is described as ongoing issuance rather than a near-term cliff unlock. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/near-protocol?utm_source=openai))
A $3.8M NEAR Intents infrastructure exploit occurred October 1, 2026, but reports state it affected the Intents/Omni flow rather than NEAR mainnet; it is not the primary current risk.
